name: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp.
description: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp. is a natural resource company focused on acquiring and exploring mineral properties and royalty interests in Nevada and Idaho, primarily targeting gold. The company holds multiple early-stage properties including the Swales Property on the Carlin Trend in Elko County and the Agai-Pah, Loman, and Lazy Claims properties in Mineral County, Nevada. The company is in the early exploration stage, conducting geological mapping, surface sampling, and initial drilling programs across its Nevada portfolio.
